items.text: Released August 5, 2026, the film initially had very limited commercial visibility. The supplied note reports opening-day receipts around RMB 3,400 and first-week receipts around RMB 5,500.
items.verification: Opening date and rounded opening-day and first-week receipts corroborated against the linked box-office page on October 2, 2026. Other production details not independently audited.

items.text: The note reports widespread criticism and incredulity about animation quality alongside curiosity-driven ticket purchasing.
items.verification: The linked August 15 report supports critical reception and curiosity; no individual-level causal identification.

items.text: Exhibitors reportedly differed over whether to add screenings: some responded to demand, while others questioned rewarding poor quality.
items.verification: Qualitative contrast supported by the linked August 15 reporting. Later national screening shares remain unverified here.

items.text: The note describes polarized audience ratings, memes, remixed clips, handmade promotional materials, and participation extending beyond conventional film evaluation.
items.verification: Retained as case-note observations. Exact rating distributions and all linked reporting were not independently authenticated in this revision.

items.text: The note describes a rapid commercial reversal followed by slower momentum. Its daily and later cumulative figures are historical claims with differing source coverage.
items.verification: The live box-office page corroborates a substantial cumulative reversal; it does not verify every daily figure or the note’s exact historical cutoff.
